title: Pairing QR payload
description: Encoded as: dc1: + base64url(utf8(JSON)) without padding. n is 16 random bytes, base64url-encoded (22 chars). exp is unix seconds; phones MUST reject payloads older than exp (checked against their own clock with 60s slack).

h.description: Host name or IP literal of the PC listener. May be absent in manual mode.
